githubDescription:
SakuraCord v0.1.6 Beta 5 adds interactive bot messages and native modal forms, introduces in-app bug reports and feature suggestions, and overhauls slash commands. Commands now work in threads, voice-channel chats, and existing forum posts, alongside improvements to the Inbox and webhook message display.

## Bot interactions and forms

- Added support for buttons and select menus in bot messages, including member, role, channel, and mentionable selections.
- Added native modal forms opened by commands and message controls, with text fields, select menus, checkboxes, radio buttons, and file uploads.
- Added form validation, default selections, and submission feedback, with entered values retained after a rejected submission.
- Added loading indicators and handling for delayed responses, private replies, and interaction failures.

## Bug reports and suggestions

- Added native bug reports and feature suggestions through `/bug`, `/suggest`, and the Help menu, with a review step before filing under your signed-in Discord account.
- Added attachments and optional system information, sanitized API logs, and panic-save diagnostics to reports.
- Added matching existing reports so you can follow an issue instead of filing a duplicate, and preserved unfinished drafts when closing the form.

## Slash commands

- Rebuilt the command editor with editable argument fields, keyboard navigation, multiline text values, and validation for missing or invalid options.
- Added slash commands to threads, voice-channel chats, and existing forum posts, with independent drafts and suggestions for the main conversation and thread pane.
- Added Frequently Used commands synchronized with Discord, improved search ordering, and redesigned command browsing by app.
- Added searchable Apps menus for message and user commands.
- Added built-in commands for message formatting, text-to-speech, GIF and sticker searches, direct messages, and thread creation, plus `/nick` to change or reset your server nickname.
- Fixed command availability in DMs and prevented stale autocomplete and member-search results from replacing newer suggestions.

## Inbox

- Added native macOS tabs for Unread and Mentions and smoother group expansion and collapse animations.
- Kept loaded content visible when switching tabs or refreshing, reducing unnecessary reloads.
- Fixed delayed settings updates reverting your selected tab or recently changed collapsed groups.

## Message display and pickers

- Fixed webhook names, avatars, profiles, and message grouping so different personas using the same webhook retain their own identities, including avatars that arrive after the message.
- Improved app names and artwork across commands and menus, and fixed media rendering in app message components.
- Improved section-sidebar scrolling and bounce behavior in command, emoji, and sticker pickers.

## Installation

- Documented Homebrew installation and updates for regular releases on Apple Silicon using `brew install --cask SakuraCordApp/tap/sakuracord`.

**Full Changelog:** [v0.1.6-Beta-4...v0.1.6-Beta-5](https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/compare/v0.1.6-Beta-4...v0.1.6-Beta-5)
discordAnnouncement:
**Bot interactions, native forms, and in-app reports 🌙**

**Highlights**
- Use buttons and select menus in bot messages, including member, role, and channel selections.
- Fill out native modal forms opened by bots, with text fields, choices, checkboxes, and file uploads.
- Report bugs and suggest features inside SakuraCord, with attachments, optional diagnostics, and matching existing reports.
- A rebuilt command editor adds better keyboard controls, synced Frequently Used commands, searchable Apps menus, and built-ins including `/nick`.
- Slash commands now work in threads, voice-channel chats, and existing forum posts.
- Native Inbox tabs retain loaded content, with fixes for webhook identities and picker scrolling.
